<thought>We need to provide all possible precursor combinations when applying the template (ID 1141) to the target molecule. The template corresponds to electrophilic bromination of an aromatic ring, converting a dimethylbenzene substrate plus Br2 into a brominated product. Therefore the precursors are bromine (Br2, SMILES "BrBr") and the dimethylbenzene substrate (SMILES "Cc1ccccc1C"). Return this as a list of lists. </thought>
<final_answer>[['BrBr', 'Cc1ccccc1C']]</final_answer>
